meta.source: Colours: friendsofpakistan.org (Squarespace site palette and computed styles, logo pixels), read 2026-09-24. Type, spacing and components: the Solve Study system (solve.mit.edu).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Friends of Pakistan yellow (the site's accent, hsl 46.8 100% 50%). Fills yellow section bands, the primary button, the square CTA, badges, carousel arrows, the reached timeline dot and the 4px caption rule on solver cards. Text on it is `on-accent` (black, 13.4:1). As text only on the green bands (8.6:1) or black (13.4:1) — eyebrows, status lines, footer heads; never on white or `off-white` (1.4:1).

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button. Derived for this system (the source defines no hover shade): `primary` at 90% lightness. Black text on it 10.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: The site's headline green. Display headlines and section titles on light grounds (6.6:1 on `off-white`, 7.2:1 on white, 4.6:1 on `primary` for 24px+ headings); link underlines; form-field borders; success. Not a ground for white text — use `brand-green-deep`.

tokens.name: brand-green-deep
tokens.usage: Ground of the dark bands (hero, stats, challenge cards, footer): the logo green (#004e00) taken a step darker so white text reads at 13.4:1 and `primary` text at 8.6:1.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Body text on light grounds (19:1 on `off-white`) and text on `primary`. The site also uses it for its pill buttons.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White bands, card and menu panels; text on the green bands.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: The site's light accent (hsl 60 4.3% 95.5%): the default page ground, alternating with white bands.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: The site's dark accent (hsl 0 0% 22%). Secondary text on light grounds (10.7:1 on `off-white`).

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: #fafafa. Timeline rail and upcoming dots on the green bands; hover fill of the white button.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: #f5f5f5. Kept from the base system; too close to `off-white` (1.0:1) to mark anything on it — use on white only.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: #e5e5e5. Fill of the cancel button (visible on both off-white and white; gray-800 label 12:1).

tokens.name: gray-light
tokens.usage: A standalone light grey the source theme defines beside the neutral scale; image placeholders on white.

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: #d4d4d4. Hover fill of the cancel button; range-slider track; `ink-soft` on the green bands (9.1:1).

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: #a1a1a1. Kept from the base system for admin-style field focus rings; 2.6:1 on white, so not for anything that must be seen.

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: #737373. Outline of default checkboxes and radios on white (4.7:1).

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: #404040. Border of a focused default input (10.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: gray-800
tokens.usage: #262626. Label of the white and cancel buttons; prose table cells (15:1 on white).

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: #171717. Hover label of the white button; the focus outline on light grounds (16:1 on off-white, 11:1 on yellow).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: #fb2c36. Danger-button border; invalid-input border on focus. Kept from the base system (the site defines no error colour). 3.8:1 on white — never small text.

tokens.name: danger-600
tokens.usage: #e7000b. Label of the danger button on white (4.8:1). 4.3:1 on `off-white` — keep danger text on white.

tokens.name: danger-400
tokens.usage: #ff6467. Resting border of an invalid field, always with the error in words.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state: an alias of `brand-green`, so it reads as text (7.2:1 on white) — pair it with a word or icon anyway.

tokens.name: hover-yellow
tokens.usage: Hover colour of the header's Log In link on dark grounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section ground: `off-white` in Light, deep green in Dark (the hero, stats, challenge cards and footer).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, labels and arrow links on `surface` (19:1 on off-white, 13.4:1 on deep green) and, in Light, on `primary` (13.4:1) and white (21:1).

tokens.name: ink-brand
tokens.usage: Display headlines and section titles, as the site sets them: green on `off-white` (6.6:1), white (7.2:1) and `primary` (4.6:1, 24px+ only); white on the green bands (13.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and meta on `surface`: 10.7:1 on off-white, 9.1:1 on deep green.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: mega-menu column dividers, button-group dividers, the white button's border, the footer's bottom rule. 1.8:1 on off-white, 2.1:1 on deep green — decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Rules that carry meaning: the stat underline, outline badges, hollow buttons.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Borders of text fields, selects, checkboxes and radios, and their 1px focus ring: green on light grounds (6.6:1 on off-white), yellow on the green bands (8.6:1) — both clear the 3:1 control floor.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Underline colour of inline links (the text stays `ink`); as link text on its own, 6.6:1 on off-white and 8.6:1 on deep green.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of `primary` for component code: the yellow fill in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text, arrows and marks on a yellow fill (13.4:1 on `primary`, 10.9:1 on `primary-dark`).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. gray-900 on off-white and yellow (16:1, 11:1), white on deep green (13.4:1).

tokens.name: scrim-image
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the transparent-to-scrim gradient over solver and impact tiles — deep green at 80%, tying photos to the green bands; white captions stay at 7.4:1 even over a white photo.

tokens.name: scrim-header
tokens.usage: Top stop of the header's fade over hero imagery (the site's own 50% black overlay).

tokens.name: scrim-band
tokens.usage: Flat dim over a band's background photo — the site's charcoal overlay at 40%.

tokens.name: scrim-card
tokens.usage: Light dim over challenge-card images.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Freight Text Pro Light (Adobe Fonts, licensed; no file ships). Crimson Pro 300 stands in where the kit is not loaded. Serif is only ever Light (300), set large, sentence case.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements. 90px under 1024px, 100px from 1024px, 120px from 1280px; line-height 1 below 1024px.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles. 50px with line-height 1 under 1024px.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headlines on white and gold bands. 42px under 1024px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in the stats band, underlined with a 1px `line-strong` rule. 72px under 1024px.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Freight Sans Pro Semibold (600). Source Sans 3 stands in where the kit is not loaded.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card-group and offer headings in sentence case.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Section titles and mega-menu column heads. Always uppercase (text-transform), usually centred over a carousel or grid.

styles.name: heading-5
styles.usage: Card titles, solver names, footer column heads (in gold on black).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Book (350) is the default weight; the homepage sets its paragraphs in Light (300).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We find, fund and help scale the best solutions.
styles.usage: Default text (the source's default-font-settings and prose): 18px / 1.3889, weight 350.

styles.name: body-light
styles.sample: These challenges take on the hardest problems communities face.
styles.usage: Intro and section paragraphs on the homepage.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Descriptions over images on solver cards (prose-sm).

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: How can we close education gaps while improving outcomes?
styles.usage: Challenge-card summaries (leading-snug, 1.33).

styles.name: legal
styles.usage: Footer legal lines, centred.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: The status line on challenge cards, in gold on black; the word Status: in 700.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Semibold (600) uppercase is the site's interface voice: every button, link, badge and nav item.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Impact-area label above a card title, gold on black.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges on card images.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Default button label (44px control). Sizes: sm 14px, lg and xl 18px, 2xl 20px.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation, white over the hero.

styles.name: menu-link
styles.usage: Mega-menu and mobile-menu links: uppercase at Book weight.

styles.name: link-arrow
styles.usage: Arrow links under body copy.

styles.name: link-arrow-lg
styles.usage: Arrow links that close a section or offer.

styles.name: cta-square
styles.usage: The gold square call-to-action.

styles.name: stat-caption
styles.usage: Caption under a stat number.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px step (--spacing: .25rem) plus three custom steps (13, 15, 30). Names are the step number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an arrow link's label and arrow; eyebrow-to-title gap; stacked card footer rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of badges and small buttons; mega-menu panel padding; badge inset from the image corner.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding; challenge-card side and bottom padding; heading-to-paragraph gap; footer list gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Square-CTA inner gap; stat caption offset; arrow-link top margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Challenge-card top padding; solver-caption inset and rule gap; mega-menu link gap; footer heading gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Container side padding; section padding under 1024px; impact-tile label inset; footer column box padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Square-CTA padding at 768px+.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Header nav gap; mega-menu column padding; footer row gap.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: Custom step: mega-menu column top offset.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Custom step: two-column gap at 1024px; carousel-arrow width; footer bottom-bar offset.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding from 1024px; header height (see `nav-height`).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Two-column gap from 1280px; offsets that drop a column below the headline.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of black bands under 1024px.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Custom step the source theme defines (7.5rem); keep for oversized band offsets.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of black bands and the challenge carousel from 1024px.

radius.note: Square. Every button, card, badge, input and image has 0 corners; only dots and radios are round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, badges, inputs, images, panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Timeline dots and radio inputs only.

tokens.name: shadow-3xl
tokens.usage: Challenge cards, the photo that overlaps a gold band, the mega-menu panel.

borderWidth.note: Hairline, heavy, and the caption rule.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, inputs, hairlines.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio outlines in public forms.

tokens.name: border-4
tokens.usage: The gold rule left of a solver-card caption.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and controls (with not-allowed cursor).

tokens.name: opacity-hover-menu
tokens.usage: Mega-menu links on hover.

tokens.name: opacity-hover-footer

tokens.name: opacity-scrim-hover
tokens.usage: Solver-tile gradient on hover (impact tiles drop to 0.2).

tokens.name: z-header

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal backdrops.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Header height; the mega menu hangs from it.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width (screen-2xl).

tokens.name: container-pad
tokens.usage: Container side padding (16px in the header under 480px).

tokens.name: menu-width
tokens.usage: Mega-menu panel width.

tokens.name: square-cta
tokens.usage: Square-CTA side from 1280px (150px at 768px+).

tokens.usage: xs

tokens.usage: sm
